app.title: Show HN: NanoMuse – An open-source AI agent for your phone and computer
app.author: ilreb
app.description: A lightweight, cross‑platform AI agent framework that runs locally on Android, iOS, and desktop, with plug‑in support for custom skills.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and run the build script for Android/iOS.
Start the desktop CLI agent and issue a simple task (e.g., fetch weather).
Verify the agent logs and response latency are within acceptable limits.
